purpose: Assemble the three results of this session that survived their own tests, and measure whether the combination is better than its parts. Nothing new is searched; every component is already on the record.

components_and_where_they_came_from.component: equal weight across the saved books rather than selecting one
components_and_where_they_came_from.evidence: holding all five returns 50.59% at Sharpe 2.02 against 10.07% at 0.47 for holding the trailing best, and beats random choice, which selection does not
Sharpe near 0.95 across two independent windows of fourteen and nineteen years, correlations of -0.087 to +0.149 against four of the five books, effective bets 2.48 to 3.08

components_and_where_they_came_from.component: a drawdown overlay driven by the book's own equity curve
components_and_where_they_came_from.evidence: halving exposure 8% below the running peak improved maximum drawdown from -20.3% to -16.1%; the macro-regime alternative bought a seventh of that on a far longer sample

declared_before_running.equity_sleeve: equal weight across the five saved dashboard books, rebalanced weekly, no selection
declared_before_running.trend_sleeve: the Step 201 sleeve at its lowest leverage setting, which is the unlevered book
declared_before_running.trend_leverage_choice_rationale: The lowest setting is chosen because it is the only one that is not a leverage decision. Picking a higher point after seeing blended results would be fitting.

drawdown_overlay.source: Step 198, copied unchanged; the threshold is not re-tuned here

questions: Does adding the trend sleeve improve risk-adjusted return over the equity composite, and at what cost in return?
Does the drawdown overlay still help once the book is already diversified, or has diversification already done that job?
Is the combination better than the best single saved book on Sharpe and drawdown simultaneously?
not_claimed: The five equity books were selected on this window. Every figure here inherits that bias and the composite cannot remove it - it only stops adding to it.
The overlapping window is short. Drawdown figures in particular are fragile on roughly 190 weeks.
No sleeve weight is selected. The grid is reported in full and the choice belongs to a forward test, not to this step.
